notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Mayo page on the lookout site has only a name and county. Map data gives coordinates, elevation and a tower type, not an agency record. Neither the NHLR nor the FFLOS Florida list (checked 2026-10-21) includes Mayo. Story is about 120 words, at the 120-word floor, and carries little beyond location because the sources support little more. Consider holding it until an agency or heritage source turns up. Brief access and status were unknown and are left out.
